item.title: Social Security trust fund depletion not a key campaign issue
item.description: Experts worry that limited public debate on the trust fund's shortfall leaves many Americans unaware of Social Security's looming problems.

item.title: Weekly quiz features two Dolly Parton questions in her honor
item.description: The singer, actress, and philanthropist could have filled an entire quiz, but others needed a chance too.

item.title: Four mental exercises to help stop obsessing over your appearance
item.description: Psychologist Diana Hill suggests that fixating on looks drains energy. These exercises may ease discomfort with self-image thoughts.

item.title: NASA prepares to launch a telescope that could transform our view of the universe
item.description: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is scheduled for launch on Aug. 30 to investigate major cosmic questions.
